_doc: Risk-relevant shadow sessions whose reconciliation evidence is PROVABLY
after-snapshot is a point-in-time broker capture, so a session missed at the
time can never be reconciled later -- without this ledger the gap counter is
a monotonically rising number that alerts forever and masks the NEXT gap.
An entry needs a non-empty `reason`; entries without one are ignored, so a
silent waiver is impossible. `blocks_review` defaults to true: a dispositioned
session still holds `ready_for_human_review` shut, because lost evidence is
still missing evidence. Setting it false is an explicit trading-governance
decision and belongs to the operator, not to whoever writes the entry.
An entry for a session that HAS reconciliation (or that is not risk-relevant)
is reported as unused so the ledger cannot rot unnoticed.
